tool.title: Models & usage
tool.about: This workspace's AI and how it is used: the API keys it brings, the models people can pick in Ask, who is active, what they ask, add and open, the AI that takes and what it costs, for everyone and for each person. Your own numbers are under You.
tool.aboutSelf: Your own numbers in this workspace — the days you were active, what you asked, added and opened, and the AI that took, beside the workspace median — and the models you can pick in Ask.

menu.title: In Ask's model menu
menu.intro: Standard and Fast are always there. Add models from your workspace's own API key and give each a name: everyone sees the name in the model menu under the question box, never the provider's model id.
menu.introSelf: Pick one in the model menu under the question box. Standard and Fast are always there; your workspace's admins can add more.
menu.connectFirst: Connect your workspace's own API key to offer more models. Until then everyone picks Standard or Fast.
menu.chooseMainFirst: Your API key is connected but has no main model yet. Choose one on API keys, then offer more models here.
menu.noneOfferedSelf: Your workspace offers Standard and Fast only.
